title: Iran's Khamenei warns against divisions after 'enemy's defeat on battlefield'
summary: Iran's Supreme ​Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said ​in a message on Thursday that Iran's enemies, having ​been ‌defeated on ⁠the battlefield, were now ‌seeking to undermine public resilience ⁠and sow internal divisions.
